metadata.description: Flux Point Studios engineering harnesses: fluxpoint-loop (Loop Engineering — deterministic DoD gate on one agent's cycle) and fluxpoint-graph (Graph Engineering — verified multi-agent campaigns as explicit graphs).

plugins.name: fluxpoint-loop
plugins.description: Loop Engineering harness: SessionStart loop-state injection, per-edit verification, Stop-hook Definition-of-Done gate, red-team reviewer agent, and loop scaffolding templates.

plugins.name: fluxpoint-graph
plugins.description: Graph Engineering harness: declarative GRAPH.md IR compiled deterministically to Workflow scripts, compile-time invariants (typed contracts, verification tiers, no self-certifying mutators, budget ceilings), provenance-recorded evidence, and a semantic graph-auditor — with the loop harness still the only authority on done.
